# AURORA Agent

> A local Model Context Protocol (MCP) server built on FIBER, a decision context compiler.
> A typed decision query is compiled into the smallest decision-sufficient evidence region,
> delivered as a Decision Section plus a Context Certificate stating exactly what was omitted
> and whether the omission could have changed the decision. Rust workspace, 79 crates
> (engine crates prefixed bioprism-), 259 MCP tools, Apache-2.0, fully local: no network
> access, no data collection.

Key measured facts:
- Reference world: 761 facts; FIBER compiles the query to 11 facts (1.45%) and the
  deterministic oracle returns the correct verdict with all four leakage witnesses.
- The headline benchmark is a deliberate negative: on the reference world a 5-hop graph walk,
  BM25 at k=11, and FIBER select the identical eleven facts. FIBER separates from the
  baselines only on a generated discriminating world. Publishing the tie is the methodology.
- Three implementations (CPython reference, eager Rust, Rust indexed store) agree on the
  certificate digest c0da17ffc80465258345c8a538171bfd868100cd883e9a20780a0dc5477e7ea4.

Install:
- Claude Desktop: aurora-agent.mcpb (v0.1.1, Windows-only prebuilt) from
  https://github.com/AURORA-NEURO/aurora-agent/releases
- Claude Code: claude plugin marketplace add AURORA-NEURO/aurora-agent;
  claude plugin install aurora-agent@aurora
- VS Code: sideload aurora-agent-0.1.3.vsix from https://github.com/AURORA-NEURO/aurora-agent/releases/tag/v0.1.3 (registers the MCP server with VS Code 1.101+)
- MCP registry: io.github.MurariAmbati/aurora-agent v0.1.1 on registry.modelcontextprotocol.io
  (metadata listing — install via the .mcpb, the plugin marketplace, or a source build)
- Any MCP client: cargo build --release --offline, then run bioprism-mcp over stdio.

Boundary: Research and developer infrastructure: it does not diagnose an individual, recommend
treatment, triage care, enroll participants, or claim medical-device functionality.

- [Overview](https://aurora-neuro.github.io/aurora-agent/): what the compiler does, the
  measurement, install paths.

  negative and the discriminating world.
- [Explorer](https://aurora-neuro.github.io/aurora-agent/explore.html): one real compile of the
  reference world, embedded verbatim — the typed query, the 11-of-761 selection, the Context
  Certificate, and the verify result.
- [Docs map](https://aurora-neuro.github.io/aurora-agent/docs.html): curated repository
  documentation.

  comparison, privacy, platforms, license.

  grant-authorised autonomous mission driving — autonomous workflows, with receipts.
